_comment: Long full-window capture in AUTO mode - read a signal over a wide window (seconds) and transfer the WHOLE record. Uses MANual timebase (horizontal_mode) so record_length + sample_rate are AUTHORITATIVE: the acquired record equals what you capture, instead of the scope auto-managing a huge record and the read pulling only a sliver (what dc_read did at 100 kS/s). record_length 10000 (a valid Tek record length) at 333.33 S/s = a 30 s window (10000 / 333.33). For other windows at 10000 pts, change sample_rate: 250 -> 40 s, 500 -> 20 s, 1000 -> 10 s, 200 -> 50 s, 100 -> 100 s. AUTO trigger (free-runs; a signal with no clean edge). CH1 DC 5 V/div, 1 MOhm (automotive levels). Use: configure_scope(alias, 'long_read', '1') then capture_scope(alias, '1'). Verify with get_scope_config_report - the scope quantizes sample_rate to its nearest achievable, but record_length stays 10000 so the full window still transfers. Do NOT also pass duration_s here (MANual derives s/div from record_length + sample_rate).
name: long_read
